version_bindings.application: ShiftMind Story 5.7 live conversation suite, extended by Story 5.12, over the authenticated HTTP path against a disposable composed stack
version_bindings.evaluator: independent application/fixture reads per turn plus a separately configured judge (TypeSafe Jev typed scores, evals/live_conversations/jev_judge.py GRADING_RULES and verdict_from); a judge pass can never override a fact or effect failure
version_bindings.policy: production grant composition (application/capabilities/registry.py); compute-risk modules are withheld from an ordinary planner turn
version_bindings.prompt: agent/scheduling_instructions.py as built into the measured image; authored user turns in evals/live_conversations/scenarios.json
version_bindings.solver: real CP-SAT worker run started through POST /api/v1/schedule-runs in Scenario B; no solver participates in Scenarios A, C, D and E
